findings.detail: For the American Academy revolver row, amortized cost is disclosed as a dash while fair value is (3); the extracted holding stored cost as -3000.0.

rationale: Class 2/aggregate weak fmt_cost review: the raw SOI cost column is in thousands and several parenthesized negative cost rows are source-disclosed, but the American Academy Holdings revolver row has amortized cost shown as a dash and fair value shown as (3). The bundle's extracted holdings include this row with observed cost -3000.0, so the cost value is not supported by the source cost cell and appears copied from the fair value column.
